text:
sanya: midweek rollcall — quick async status (what I did / blocker / today) :wave:

sanya: did: pushed spanish_promptset_v2 to staging and triggered the nightly evals. noticed a 1.8% avg drop in generation-quality metrics vs baseline on ES test slice.

sanya: blocker: can't repro locally — my tokenizer gives different token counts than the staging runtime for some prompts (looks like stop-sequence handling + trailing whitespace). need someone to sanity-check tokenization + the export pipeline. :thinking_face:

ken: @sanya can you paste one minimal example that diverges? I can run a quick compare on the container image we use in staging. :eyes:

sanya: here's a failing pair — baseline vs new: 
```
prompt: "Traduce al español: It's raining cats.
"
baseline tokens:  [50256, 1204, 326, 13]
new tokens:       [50256, 1204, 326, 13, 220]
```
Seems like an extra stop token (220) sneaks in when prompts have trailing newline in some places.

eval-bot: nightly-eval report attached — summary: ES-slice BLEU -1.8%, perplexity +3.2%, regression-tag: stop-token-mismatch. Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/nightlies/2432109876/*.tar.gz

eva: I pushed a small prompt formatting cleanup in branch promptset/spanish-trim (removed stray newlines from a few templates) — might help. Can someone kick a staging rerun after ken's token check? :rocket:

ken: will run tokenizer diff on staging image and local pypackage this afternoon. command I'll use: `python -m redwood.tools.token_diff --model-dir staging-image --prompt-file sample_es.txt` — if it reproduces, next step is to inspect export script that writes prompt set JSON.

nate: I can take the export script review/CR. @ken when you have the failing reproduction, drop the trace here and I'll open a small PR to normalize trailing whitespace and force a canonical stop token mapping.

ken: quick note — staging uses a trimmed tokenizer patch (v0.9.3) while local dev uses v0.9.2 by default. that could be the culprit. recommend upgrading local env and re-running.

sanya: thanks — upgrading now. also FYI I opened PR #789 to update the Spanish prompt variants (formatting + a couple phrasing tweaks). would appreciate review/merge if it passes CI.

eva: i'll kick a manual rerun after PR #789 is green.

nate: will queue the export normalization PR once ken confirms reproduction; aiming for PR + tests by EOD.

ken: status update: reproduced locally after upgrading tokenizer to v0.9.3. extra token comes from the runtime stop-token mapping. attaching quick diff in next message.

ken: diff gist: https://gist.github.com/kent/abcd1234 — TL;DR: map "\n" and trailing spaces to canonical STOP token during export.

sanya: clear. thanks team. i'll hold off on rolling to prod until we have rerun results. planning: block cleared -> merge PR #789, run staging-eval, then promote.

eval-bot: staging-rerun kicked by eva at 15:12 UTC; will post results when complete.

nate: follow-up — I'll also add a short unit test to the export script to assert token counts stable across tokenizer versions. keeps this from regressing.

sanya: final note — small ask to reviewers: prioritize the CR for the export change since this is affecting multiple locales (es + pt). thanks :pray:

ken: noted. I'll review #789 + export PR by EOD and leave comments.

sanya: end of update — ping if you need me for any handoffs.
